integrity.computational_evidence: Standalone Python direct-neighbor-mask enumeration; checks do not establish the infinite theorem.
integrity.proof_method: Local common-neighbor hitting constraints, bipartite matching-cover theorem, inclusion-minimal classification and labeled counting.
integrity.scientific_residual_risk: An equivalent result under alternative neighborhood-transversal terminology could be missing from indexed literature.

scientific_limitations: Finite simple direct products of two complete graphs with both factor orders at least four; inclusion-maximal total mutual visibility only; not an all-total-set enumerator and not other visibility variants.
title: Two-layer maximal total-mutual-visibility polynomial for direct products of complete graphs
